source.title: What should I do with my Khaz'gorite Ore as a JC? — firsthand 100 R2 Khaz'gorite prospecting comment

notes: CORRECTION to dragonflight-20261030-1306, same firsthand cohort, NOT a second independent study. Source explicitly says 100 rank-2 Khaz'gorite Ore in 20 completed prospects and no Illimited Diamond of any quality. Therefore castsWithDrop=0 and histogram={0:20} are source-supported for the pooled any-rank Illimited Diamond outcome. Input item ID 190313 maps to rank-2 Khaz'gorite Ore (WoW Price Hub https://wowpricehub.com/us/illidan/item/Khaz%27gorite%20Ore-190313, explicitly TIER_2). Source does not report output rank, so outputItemID and outputRank stay null; do not apply pooled 20-cast zeros to each diamond quality as independent samples. Other gems yielded but quantities unreported. Historical January 2023; profession build and patch not independently established beyond date.
